title: spergularia bracteata
intro: Spergularia bracteata, commonly known as star clover or sand spurry, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Caryophyllaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Spergularia bracteata include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
